Same DoubleTake fabric story as the bra and legging: textured outer layer that catches the eye, Revive™ midweight underneath for coverage and support. The 15" length hits right, and the internal bike short has a drop-in pocket that fits your phone so you're not carrying anything you don't need to. It's the kind of piece that makes people ask where you got it, whether you're on the court, at the range, or just out. Completes the DoubleTake set, but playful enough to mix with whatever else you're already wearing. products.title: Momentum Tech Polo -- Ash Blue Honeycomb
products.description: Description: For the player who's out there every week. This polo's got everything you need to play hard and stay cool: Glacier Cooling Technology, raglan sleeves that don't fight your swing, and side slits so nothing pulls when you move. The zippered placket and collar stays keep things sharp from first serve to last putt, and the subtle jacquard texture adds depth without being loud about it. Classic fit, high-performance fabric, and good enough to wear off the course, too. Who are we to stop your Momentum? products.title: Power Denim 5-Pocket Jeans
products.description: Unmatched durability meets unmatched comfort in the Power Denim 5-Pocket Jeans. Crafted from ultra-tough Dyneema® fibers and US cotton, they're lightweight yet incredibly tear-resistant. These jeans feature 4-way stretch, a Flexbelt® waistband for all-day ease, and reinforced seams that add to the sturdiness. With tool-ready details like hidden clip pockets, double hammer loops, and a painter loop, plus a modern stone washed or black-washed finish, they combine rugged performance with a sleek, utility-focused fit. Considered the “world’s strongest fiber™,” Dyneema® is an ultra-lightweight, high-strength fiber that has been proven to be 15 times stronger than steel. Originally developed for military and ballistic applications, the material’s exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, tear resistance, and abrasion resistance combine to provide unparalleled durability without compromising on comfort or flexibility. When blended with traditional cotton, you get a denim that enables you to move faster for longer, making you more tactical on the job—without sacrificing on protection. Elastic Flexbelt® waistband Darted knees for freedom of movement Secure knee pad pockets Comfortable, mesh-lined interior knee pocket 2 rounded reinforced slash pockets Integrated coin pocket within the right slash pocket Zip pocket on the left side Side pockets on each thigh for attaching a tape measure and knife 2 back welt pockets, one with a flap and snap fastener 2 side pockets on the back with a hammer loop Knife pocket on the right leg with reinforced opening Secure cell phone pocket Deep cargo pocket on the left leg with an internal cell phone pocket and secondary zip pocket All pocket flaps have a firm insert to strengthen the hold D-ring next to the first belt loop on the right side Triple-stitched seams on the inner leg Why we made it: The industry standards for hot weather, heavy-duty work pants wasn’t quite cutting it for some of our customers, so we went out and re-engineered a classic. The Ripstop Cargo Work Pants e.s.e:pic combine the signature toughness of cotton duck work pants but with a more lightweight, breathable ripstop fabric that’s just as strong but much more comfortable on hot days. The triple-stitched seams, reinforced knees, and utility pockets provide necessary support when the job gets tough. And the sharp, polished fit has you looking professional everywhere you go. Material: The fabric was engineered to be unbelievably lightweight, breathable, and tear-resistant but with a bit of stretch to prevent any tugging—allowing you to work with ease. Shell 50% Polyamide / 48% Cotton / 2% Elastane (approx. 6.34 oz/sq yard) Size and fit: A comfortable, relaxed fit with a medium rise on the waist Straight cut legs for a more polished look on site The Flexbelt® waistband expands with you as you move on the job Darted knees provide extra freedom of movement Elastic fabric offers plenty of stretch, perfect for active job sites. Care instructions: Machine-wash at warm: 104 °F / 40 °C Do not bleach Tumble dry on low temperature Iron on low heat Do not dry clean
